description: List recent email outcomes for this account. Recipients are masked; use this to diagnose queued, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, complained, or failed mail. `sentToday` counts the last 24 hours on a rolling basis, while `sharedTrial.sendsUsed` counts the account's lifetime sends on the shared trial, so the two legitimately differ. Does not send mail.

project.description: A project id from list_projects. Runs this call in that project instead of the connection default.
